  config.protocols[connector=HLS]: served on `[server] http_bind` already: MistServer's HLS output has no port of its own either (`capa["deps"] = "HTTP"` in output_hls.cpp), it rides the HTTP connector

Approximated:
  config.protocols[connector=HTTP]: -> `[server] http_bind` on port 8080; bound to 127.0.0.1, not MistServer's usual 0.0.0.0: without `[admin]` Caudal refuses to start on a non-loopback address — set up `[admin]` (commented in below), then change this to 0.0.0.0 to match MistServer's original reach
  streams.live-main.DVR: -> `[buffer] window_secs` (30000 ms asked here); Caudal's buffer window is one global setting, not per stream, so the largest DVR across all streams wins

No Caudal equivalent:
